previous.based_on: 0.1.4 (licensing-clean: no FTN charting, no participation data), same settings and volume model
previous.calibration: anytime_td, passing_tds and fantasy_points refitted on 2021-23 from this version's own walk-forward probabilities (0.1.1 values were {"anytime_td": [0.1295, 1.0764], "passing_tds": [-0.102, 1.153], "fantasy_points": [0.1479, 1.1746]}); every other market keeps 0.1.1's calibration.
previous.change_from_0.1.4: Touchdown rates follow the team's projected points: rate x exp(a + b*log(points / 22.11)), per kind (rush, rec, pass). Slopes fitted on 2021-23 by Poisson regression on the clean model's expected touchdowns; a is set so the average multiplier over 2021-23 is 1 (redistribution only), because the touchdown level was not stable across 2021-23 (rush: positive every season but its interval included 0; rec: signs differed by season; pass: drifting toward 0).
previous.evaluation: Out of sample on 2024 and 2025 (never used to fit anything): see Research Phase 3.
